note: Added to suite 01M22ETHF4SMEDY6F089GSGM43 with the prefix 'ClickAI: '. Text simulations: the caller is evals@sarvam.ai, which ClickAI treats as a test caller (bookings never saved, no leads). Speech-level language detection is not exercised by text runs.

test_cases.name: Greeting has no self-introduction
test_cases.user_scenario: Say hello and ask whether the clinic is open today. Then say thanks, bye.

expected_behaviors.name: No self-introduction
expected_behaviors.description: The opening greeting and replies never give the agent a personal name and never describe itself as a virtual assistant unless asked.

expected_behaviors.name: Short welcome
expected_behaviors.description: The first message is a short welcome with the business name and asks how it can help.

test_cases.name: Booking intent with date and latest time
test_cases.user_scenario: Say: I want to book an appointment today by 8 PM. When asked which service, say root canal. Accept the first time offered that is before 8 PM, give the name Anil, confirm, then say bye.

expected_behaviors.name: Retains date and time limit
expected_behaviors.description: Never asks again for the date; offers only times at or before 8 PM today.

expected_behaviors.name: Asks only what is missing
expected_behaviors.description: Asks for the service and name, not for anything already given.

expected_behaviors.name: Canonical service
expected_behaviors.description: Treats root canal as the configured Root Canal Treatment.

test_cases.name: Unsupported service is refused
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask to book a general checkup tomorrow morning. If told it is not offered, ask what is offered, then say you will think about it and end.

expected_behaviors.name: Refuses unoffered service
expected_behaviors.description: Says general checkup is not offered and names only the configured services.

expected_behaviors.name: No substitution
expected_behaviors.description: Does not check availability or book any other service unless the caller picks one.

test_cases.name: Ambiguous service is clarified
test_cases.user_scenario: Say you need something done for your tooth tomorrow. Answer the clarifying question by choosing tooth removal. Then say you will call back later.

expected_behaviors.name: Clarifies
expected_behaviors.description: Asks which of the configured services the caller means instead of guessing.

test_cases.name: Hindi service name maps to configured service
test_cases.user_scenario: Write only in Hindi (Devanagari): मुझे कल दाँत निकलवाना है, शाम को। Accept a time offered, give the name Meena, confirm.

expected_behaviors.name: Maps service
expected_behaviors.description: Understands the request as the configured Tooth Removal service.

expected_behaviors.name: Replies in Hindi
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Hindi.

expected_behaviors.name: Honest result
expected_behaviors.description: Does not say the appointment is booked unless the booking tool replied CONFIRMED.

test_cases.name: Telugu service name maps to configured service
test_cases.user_scenario: Write only in Telugu: నాకు రేపు పన్ను తీయించుకోవాలి. Give the name Ravi when asked. Then say you will call back later.

expected_behaviors.name: Maps service
expected_behaviors.description: Understands the request as the configured Tooth Removal service.

expected_behaviors.name: Replies in Telugu
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Telugu.

test_cases.name: Telugu-English mixed request
test_cases.user_scenario: Write Telugu with English words: నాకు tomorrow evening root canal appointment కావాలి. Then answer naturally in the same mix and end politely.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands code-mixing
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps date tomorrow, evening and Root Canal Treatment without asking again.

expected_behaviors.name: Natural reply
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Telugu (English business words allowed), not in pure English.

test_cases.name: Hinglish request
test_cases.user_scenario: Write Hinglish in Latin script: kal subah 10 baje root canal ka appointment chahiye, naam Suresh. Confirm when asked.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps tomorrow, 10 AM, Root Canal Treatment and the name Suresh without asking again.

expected_behaviors.name: Natural reply
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Hindi or Hinglish.

test_cases.name: English to Telugu switch keeps context
test_cases.user_scenario: Start in English: I need a tooth removal tomorrow. After the agent's first reply, switch to Telugu for the rest: సాయంత్రం 5 గంటలకు కుదురుతుందా? Then give the name Lakshmi.

expected_behaviors.name: Switches language
expected_behaviors.description: After the caller switches to Telugu, replies in Telugu.

expected_behaviors.name: Keeps context
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps the service and date; does not restart.

test_cases.name: Gujarati caller
test_cases.user_scenario: Write only in Gujarati: મારે કાલે દાંત કઢાવવો છે. Then ask the clinic timings.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands
expected_behaviors.description: Understands the tooth removal request and the timings question.

expected_behaviors.name: No wrong language
expected_behaviors.description: Does not reply in Telugu to a Gujarati caller.

test_cases.name: Requested time not free
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask for a root canal tomorrow at 1 PM. If 1 PM is not free, accept the nearest time offered, name Kiran, confirm.

expected_behaviors.name: Honest availability
expected_behaviors.description: Says whether 1 PM is free based on the availability reply; never invents a time.

expected_behaviors.name: Offers real alternatives
expected_behaviors.description: If not free, offers only nearby times from the availability reply.

test_cases.name: Time correction
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask for tooth removal tomorrow at 10 in the morning, then immediately correct: no, 11. Give the name Asha and confirm.

expected_behaviors.name: Updates only the time
expected_behaviors.description: Switches to 11 without restarting or asking for the service again.

test_cases.name: Phone agreement is not booking consent
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask for a root canal tomorrow evening, pick a time, give the name Vijay. When the agent mentions your phone number, say 'yes that number is fine, but don't book yet, I need to check with my wife'. Then end.

expected_behaviors.name: No booking without consent
expected_behaviors.description: Does not call the booking tool after the caller said not to book yet.

test_cases.name: Failed booking and callback wording
test_cases.user_scenario: Book a tooth removal tomorrow at the first time offered, name Prakash, confirm. If it is not booked and a callback is offered, accept it. Then say bye.

expected_behaviors.name: No false success
expected_behaviors.description: Says the appointment could not be booked; never says booked, saved or that a request was recorded unless a tool said so.

expected_behaviors.name: Callback only when recorded
expected_behaviors.description: Promises that the team will call only if the callback tool replied RECORDED; otherwise gives the clinic phone number.

expected_behaviors.name: No repeated explanation
expected_behaviors.description: Does not repeat the same limitation twice.

test_cases.name: Enquiry without booking push
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask the price of a root canal. Then say thanks, that's all.

expected_behaviors.name: Price from facts
expected_behaviors.description: Gives the configured root canal price.

expected_behaviors.name: No push
expected_behaviors.description: Does not push the caller to book; closes briefly when the caller is done.

test_cases.name: Names and times preserved
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask for a tooth removal tomorrow at 4:30 PM, name Venkata Ramana. Confirm when asked.

expected_behaviors.name: Exact details
expected_behaviors.description: Repeats the name Venkata Ramana and 4:30 PM (or an offered alternative) exactly, with the correct date.
